package diagnosticbinding

import (
	"bytes"
	"strings"
	"testing"
	"time"

	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-learning-planner/internal/domain"
	provision "github.com/bemulima/ms-go-learning-planner/internal/usecase/diagnosticbinding"
)

func TestParseEnvironmentAcceptsOnlyCanonicalInputs(t *testing.T) {
	env := map[string]string{
		DatabaseURLEnv: "postgres://planner:secret@planner-db:5432/planner?sslmode=disable",
		CourseIDEnv:    "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111",
		CreatedAtEnv:   "2026-09-26T12:00:00.123Z",
	}
	input, err := ParseEnvironment(func(key string) string { return env[key] })
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("parse: %v", err)
	}
	if input.CourseID != env[CourseIDEnv] || input.CreatedAt != time.Date(2026, 9, 26, 12, 0, 0, 123000000, time.UTC) {
		t.Fatalf("unexpected input: %#v", input)
	}
}

func TestParseEnvironmentRejectsNonCanonicalTimestampAndInvalidBinding(t *testing.T) {
	base := map[string]string{
		DatabaseURLEnv: "postgres://planner:secret@planner-db:5432/planner?sslmode=disable",
		CourseIDEnv:    "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111",
		CreatedAtEnv:   "2026-09-26T12:00:00Z",
	}
	for name, change := range map[string]string{
		"offset":      "2026-09-26T12:00:00+00:00",
		"nanoseconds": "2026-09-26T12:00:00.123456789Z",
	} {
		t.Run(name, func(t *testing.T) {
			env := mapsClone(base)
			env[CreatedAtEnv] = change
			if _, err := ParseEnvironment(func(key string) string { return env[key] }); err != ErrInvalidInput {
				t.Fatalf("expected input error, got %v", err)
			}
		})
	}
	invalidCourse := mapsClone(base)
	invalidCourse[CourseIDEnv] = "not-a-course"
	if _, err := ParseEnvironment(func(key string) string { return invalidCourse[key] }); err != ErrInvalidInput {
		t.Fatalf("expected input error, got %v", err)
	}
}

func TestOutputAndFailureAreSafeJSON(t *testing.T) {
	createdAt := time.Date(2026, 9, 26, 12, 0, 0, 123000000, time.UTC)
	binding := domain.DiagnosticBootstrapBinding{GoalCode: provision.CanonicalGoal, DirectionCode: provision.CanonicalDirection, CourseID: "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111", BindingRevision: 1, PolicyVersion: domain.DiagnosticBootstrapPolicyV1, Active: true, CreatedAt: createdAt}
	digest, err := domain.DiagnosticBootstrapBindingDigest(binding)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	binding.BindingDigest = digest
	output, err := NewOutput(provision.Result{Status: "created", Binding: binding})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	var stdout bytes.Buffer
	if err := WriteOutput(&stdout, output); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if strings.Contains(stdout.String(), "secret") || !strings.Contains(stdout.String(), `"status":"created"`) || !strings.Contains(stdout.String(), `"schema":"planner-diagnostic-bootstrap-binding-provision.v1"`) {
		t.Fatalf("unsafe or invalid output: %s", stdout.String())
	}
	var stderr bytes.Buffer
	if err := WriteFailure(&stderr, "binding_conflict"); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if stderr.String() != "{\"schema\":\"planner-diagnostic-bootstrap-binding-provision.v1\",\"status\":\"failed\",\"reason\":\"binding_conflict\"}\n" {
		t.Fatalf("unexpected failure output: %q", stderr.String())
	}
}

func mapsClone(input map[string]string) map[string]string {
	result := make(map[string]string, len(input))
	for key, value := range input {
		result[key] = value
	}
	return result
}
